sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.
2.

Learned HCGP is directed to take notice for respondents No.1 to 6.
3.

It is the case of petitioner that he is the owner and in possession of land bearing Sy.No.17/6,
measuring 03 acres, 03 guntas situated as Zunjarkoppa village of Mudhol taluka in Bagalkote district.
It is stated by the petitioner that the State Highway of Auradh-Sadhashivgad is passing through the property of the petitioner.
The respondent authorities without providing proper notice or initiating acquisition proceedings have utilized the property of the petitioner for formation of road.
Whereby there is no acquisition or compensation paid to the petitioner.

Hence, petitioner made representations dated 06.01.2023 to the respondent authorities vide Annexure-B, B1 to B3,
for which the respondent has replied vide Annexures-C and C1 to C3.

It appears that there is no satisfactory reply given by the respondents with regard to whether the property of the petitioner has been acquired and has been utilized for Sachin S/O Bheemappa Udagatti vs The State Of Karnataka on 7 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58709739/
3 formation of the road and if so, whether the same is in by way of proper acquisition and awarding compensation to the petitioner/land looser.

sentences.text: Hence, petitioner is before this Court for a writ of mandamus direction to respondents No.3 to 6 to conduct necessary survey of the land bearing Sy.No.17/6, measuring 03 acres, 03 guntas and to identify the exact extent of land utilized by the respondent authorities for formation of the road.

4. Learned HCGP counsel for respondents No.1 to 6/State contends that a suitable reply has already been provided by Annexures-C and C1 to C3, in which the letters/representations of the petitioner is addressed.
Therefore, there is nothing further required to be done by the State, as the petitioner himself is not sure of whether his property is utilized for formation of the road.

However, learned HCGP contends that if at all there is anything missed out with regard to the representations made by the NC: 2024:KHC-D:7656 petitioner, the same will be considered in accordance with law.

5. Placing the submission of learned HCGP on record and having heard learned counsel for both parties, it is seen that the petitioner's contention is that, the land of petitioner's along with few others are utilized for formation of the road, but there is no acquisition proceedings or compensation awarded.

Therefore, the present petitioner is seeking the respondents to conduct the survey in consultation along with the ADLR, if required, for the purpose of survey and address the representations as to what is the extent of land acquired; if at all the land of the petitioner is utilized for formation of the road and to what extent.

Accordingly, I pass the following :
ORDER (i) Petition is allowed.
(ii) Writ of mandamus is issued to respondents No.3 to 6 to consider the representations of the petitioner at Annexure-B series and NC: 2024:KHC-D:7656 pass appropriate suitable orders within a period of four months from the date of receipt of copy of this order by providing suitable opportunity and if required by taking help of ADLR for the purpose of survey.

Sd/-
